mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_summaries ( user_id, summary_date, breakfast_calories, lunch_calories, dinner_calories, snack_calories, night_calories, total_calories, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{summaryDate}, #{breakfastCalories}, #{lunchCalories}, #{dinnerCalories}, #{snackCalories}, #{nightCalories}, #{totalCalories}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_summaries SET breakfast_calories = #{breakfastCalories}, lunch_calories = #{lunchCalories}, dinner_calories = #{dinnerCalories}, snack_calories = #{snackCalories}, night_calories = #{nightCalories}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
